svg.title: Ridge coefficient paths for the near-collinear fit
svg.desc: The two ridge coefficients plotted against lambda on a logarithmic axis from 10 to the minus 7 to 100, for the data y = (2, 4.05, 5.95), solid, and y = (2, 4.06, 5.94), dashed. At small lambda the coefficients approach the least-squares values (−3, 5) and (−4, 6), and the solid and dashed paths are far apart. From about lambda = 10 to the minus 3 the paths merge near (1, 1); at lambda = 0.01 they are (0.960, 1.036) and (0.950, 1.045). For large lambda both coefficients shrink towards zero.
svg.text: Damping pulls both fits onto the strong channel
Solid: y = (2, 4.05, 5.95). Dashed: y = (2, 4.06, 5.94). The two data sets disagree only through the weak channel.
